description: Estonian Topographic Database (ETAK) core data, thematic dataset "Transportation" for entire Estonia, layer E_501_tee_a: road. Layer naming: "_p" means point geometry, "_j" line geometry, "_a" polygon geometry and "_ka" polygon geometry on top of the "_a" layers. Downloadable files are updated weekly.

table:columns.name: etak_id
table:columns.description: Unique object ID of the Estonian topographic database.

table:columns.name: kood
table:columns.description: Grouping code of the layer (also part of the layer name).

table:columns.name: kood_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of kood (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: tyyp_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of tyyp (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: vajalik
table:columns.description: Attribute to keep record whether the object needs to be checked: 10 = needs to be checked on site, 20 = shape requires correction, 30 = OK, 40 = table attributes require corrections, 50 = additional base document is needed.

table:columns.name: vajalik_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of vajalik (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: andmeallik
table:columns.description: Base document ID used to insert or update the object's attributes (shapefile-truncated name of andmeallika_id; the ID refers to table alusdokumendid, field KOOD).

table:columns.name: korgusalli
table:columns.description: Base document ID used to insert or update the object's height, i.e. the Z value of each vertex (shapefile-truncated name of korgusallika_id).

table:columns.name: ruumikujua
table:columns.description: Base document ID used to insert or update the object's shape (shapefile-truncated name of ruumikujuallika_id).

table:columns.name: geom_muutm
table:columns.description: Latest date of the object's geometry change (shapefile-truncated name of geom_muutmisaeg).

table:columns.name: valjavote
table:columns.description: Extraction date from the topographic database.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax, added by the conversion.
